name: Uranium oxide glazing
summary: A lead glaze that holds uranium oxide fires to a bright orange-red. The red cannot be made with the common metal oxides at that heat.
how: Mix uranium oxide into a lead glaze.
Dip the biscuit piece in the glaze.
Fire in clean air at the glost heat.
Check each piece for an even red.

origin.note: Homer Laughlin makes the red of Fiesta ware with uranium oxide.

adoptions.via: Frederick Rhead and Homer Laughlin fire the red Fiesta glaze with uranium oxide.
